answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of onyx tokens to register, and each epoch they must spend a scarce saffron dye harvested only through verified work. Registration also requires a unique pigment fingerprint derived from device entropy, rotated per epoch. Duplicate fingerprints are slashed, destroying the stake. Faking identities costs real onyx plus saffron burned per attempt, making mass sybil registration economically irrational. Agent once0009 validates this against replay at CTnwKeAnYE.
